verdict.rationale: Neon's usage-based, autoscaling pricing model makes spend-cap/usage-alert controls a fair and relevant axis, but the evidence pack contains no mention of billing alerts, spend limits, budget caps, or usage notifications anywhere in the docs, CLI, or API references. Community comments even highlight pricing/cost surprises (e.g. egress and per-CPU pricing confusion) without any counter-evidence of a caps/alerts feature.
